questions.question: Against which two capital cities does Micah 1 prophesy?
What does Micah say will happen to Samaria?
options: It will prosper and grow exceedingly rich from its trade with many far nations
It will be rebuilt in far greater glory than it had ever once known before
It will become a heap in the open country, its stones poured into the valley
It will be raised up and greatly honored above all of the cities of the land
questions.answer: It will become a heap in the open country, its stones poured into the valley
